$description: The media field: a thumbnail of what the value names, the value itself, and the two doors to a different one. It is a LEAF a caller interpolates — the Inspector's Content tab, the Signals panel and the grid's image-cell panel each draw an empty host and `ui/media-picker.ts` mounts this into it — so it has no chrome of its own and takes its width from whatever row it lands in. **Browse is addressed through its `part`, not through a class.** `ui/regions.ts` derives `inspector/field:<prop>/browse` by finding the Browse control inside the Inspector's own `[data-prop]` row; the handle used to be `.media-picker-browse`, and a document emits no class, so `[part="browse"]` is the handle now. The four `.media-picker*` rules from `styles/overlays.css` are TRANSCRIBED here rather than shared, for the reason `doc-header.json` gives: a class a document does not emit cannot style it. `--radius` becomes `--jx-radius-sm` on the way, because a document mounted in a pane's stage is outside `<sp-theme>` and would otherwise take a fallback rather than follow the theme.

style.$description: The row's own layout and the four transcribed `.media-picker*` rules. Upload and Browse never shrink, so the FIELD is what yields width when the row is narrow — the buttons would otherwise collapse into unreadable stubs before the text did.

shown.$description: Decorative on purpose: the field beside it already states the path in text, so a caption here would be the same fact twice to a screen reader and nothing to anyone else.

oninput.description: Every keystroke, because the host debounces it: the canvas follows the typing without a document write per character.

onfocus.description: Entering the field is the earliest honest signal that a pick is coming, so the project's media are listed then rather than when Browse is pressed.

onclick.description: The button hands over ITSELF: the browser is a popover and the platform wants its invoker, both so a second press on this control toggles rather than reopens and so focus comes back here when it closes.
